title: Simulating a Run Within the Clock
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean Turing machine, $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean Turing machine, $x$ a Boolean input, and $m$ a natural number. Let $a$ be any configuration of $A$ on $x$, let $j$ be a natural number, and let $u$ be a Boolean choice word such that $j+|u|\le m$. For any work-tape contents and head positions of $S$, running the host machine on $u$ from the representation of $a$ in phase $	ext{run}$, with yard-head position $j$, gives the representation of the run of $A$ on $u$ from $a$, with yard-head position $j+|u|$; the other stated host data are preserved as specified by that representation.
